summary: Iteration 11 — Stripe Checkout + Coaching booking + Membership + mock-data-removal all verified end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 tests pass in test_iteration11_payments.py — products catalog returns coaching_session($50) + jaleter_premium($75); POST /api/payments/checkout returns real Stripe URLs containing 'checkout.stripe.com', proper txn_id, and non-null booking_id for coaching / null for premium; past scheduled_at rejected with 400; missing scheduled_at rejected with 400; unknown product rejected with 400; GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns unpaid status; GET /api/payments/status/{unknown} → 404; GET /api/coaching/bookings lists the pending booking; GET /api/user/membership → {active:false} for fresh user; all 4 payment endpoints reject missing AND invalid bearer with 401; regressions (auth login/me, forgot-password preview fallback, reset-password bad-token 400, simplefin/link invalid-token 400, /api/accounts, /api/accounts/all, /api/providers catalog, /api/support/requests POST) all still respond as before. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x812): logged in as alex+test1@jaleter.app; Home shows Net Worth $0, Budget 0%, NO '7-day stewardship streak' banner, NO fake alert (0%<80%); Budget screen shows all subcategories $0 across Give/Steward/Grow/Enjoy; Net Worth hero=$0, Cash Protection strip Cash=$0/Committed=$0/Available=$0, growth caption exact-match 'Updates with your linked accounts', NO '+4.8%' string anywhere; More→Book Coaching renders 'PICK A TIME' + 30 slots (10 business days × 10AM/2PM/4PM), 'Book & Pay $50' disabled until a slot is picked, then tap posts to /api/payments/checkout and the app navigates to a real Stripe checkout page (verified Stripe Sandbox '$50 USD' page loaded); More→Membership shows NO 'ACTIVE' pill, exact button label 'Subscribe — $75 / year', tap posts to /api/payments/checkout and redirects to Stripe. Google button is visible on Login screen. All test data (pending bookings, unpaid payment_transactions, leftover TEST_reg_* file imports from prior iterations totalling $113 on Assets list) was cleaned from MongoDB. Deprecation warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents remain (already tracked as P3 in iteration_10).

integration_issues.flow: Coaching slot picker → Stripe checkout (minor UX)
integration_issues.issue: The scheduled_at sent to POST /api/payments/checkout is serialized in UTC (e.g. '2026-07-17T10:00:00.000Z') while the slot label reads 'Fri, Jul 17 · 10:00 AM' in the browser's local timezone. In this test the two happened to match because the preview browser is on UTC, but for a real user on ET/PT the ISO in the request and the label the user tapped will represent different wall-clock hours. Not blocking (booking + Stripe URL still return correctly) but worth aligning so the confirmation email/screen matches what the user picked.

issues: Assets list showed $113 total from three TEST_reg_* file-imported entries left over by earlier iterations' regression suites. Cleaned up in this run; not a product bug — flagging so future regression tests always tear down file-import fixtures.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on every screen mount. Already tracked as P3 in iteration_10 action items — no new occurrences added by this iteration.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low): Send scheduled_at as the user's local wall-clock ISO with offset (e.g. '2026-07-17T10:00:00-04:00') instead of UTC 'Z' so the Stripe metadata and any confirmation email reflect the slot label the user actually tapped.
OPTIONAL (low, carried from iteration_10): migrate remaining shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL (low, carried from iteration_10): bump CircleBtn 38→44px to meet 44x44 touch target.
critical_code_review_comments: payments_service.py — server-side PRODUCTS catalog is the single source of truth for amount/currency; the checkout endpoint ignores any client-supplied amount. Good.

payments_service.py:_apply_paid_side_effects is idempotent (only fires when payment_status transitions from non-'paid' to 'paid'), and membership extension correctly stacks from max(current_expiry, now) + 365d. Good.
server.py:/api/payments/status/{session_id} scopes the initial lookup by session_id AND user_id — prevents user A from polling the state of user B's session. Good.
server.py:/api/coaching/bookings sorts scheduled_at DESC and limits 20 — reasonable for the UI but note there's no pagination if a heavy user ever exceeds 20 confirmed bookings. Low priority.
payments_service.py:create_pending_booking rejects sub-15-minute windows and non-ISO strings via ValueError → mapped to 400 in the route. Good.
index.tsx:1131 upcomingCoachingSlots(10) is generated with the client's local Date, but the slot.iso serialized to /api/payments/checkout is UTC (…Z). See integration_issues above.
